_doc: Documented tamper-evidence exceptions. Each entry names ONE state-log line whose chain digest is known-broken, with cause and prevention. verify() downgrades exactly these entries to prominently-reported warnings; any other break still blocks publication. The log itself is never rewritten - a tamper-evident record edited to verify would be worthless.

exceptions.cause: Caller passed a payload field named 'sha256' (the frozen subset digest) which collided with the chain-digest key at append time, so the recomputed digest cannot match.
exceptions.prevention: RESERVED field names are refused at append since the fix (state/log.py); regression-tested.
